effects.title: 滑动变焦
effects.desc: 主体大小基本不变，背景随镜头与视角反向变化而压缩或展开；需要多层深度素材。
effects.sourceDescription: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.
effects.use: 镜头运动 · 社交短视频
effects.tags: camera depth 3d cinematic 滑动变焦
effects.install: npx hyperframes add camera-dolly-zoom

effects.usageCaveat: 该效果需要主体与背景位于不同深度；单张平面素材无法直接产生真实的滑动变焦。先检查项目是否有分层素材。
